;+ ; Check that a connection to mysql is open; open one if it isn't. ; ; :Categories: ; ; SST pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; Mats Löfdahl, Institute for Solar Physics ; ; Based on mysqlcheck.pro by Marshall Perrin. ; ; :Params: ; ; handle : in, out, type=integer ; ; The lun for the database pipe. ; ; :Keywords: ; ; database : in, optional, type=string, default='sst_db' ; ; Database name to open. ; ; :History: ; ; 2005-10-05 : MP. First version. ; ; 2018-06-28 : MGL. Adapted to SST style and renamed ; red_mysql_check. Set default database. ; ; 2019-10-08 : OA. Added site check to run mysql client on polar ; remotely from La Palma (it's much faster to populate ; the database this way). ; ;- pro red_mysql_check, handle, reopen=reopen, database=database if n_elements(database) eq 0 then database="sst_db" if keyword_set(reopen) $ and n_elements(handle) ne 0 then begin free_lun, handle ;;close,handle ;;delvarx, handle endif if n_elements(handle) gt 0 then return red_currentsite,site=site case site of ;'AlbaNova': red_mysql_open, handle, database 'La Palma': red_mysql_open_remote, handle, database else: red_mysql_open, handle, database endcase end
